labEntry.title: Choose a strategy through your risk comfort
labEntry.body: Start by choosing how much short-term movement you are comfortable seeing in this simulation. Rushd will match that choice to one specific reviewed learning strategy before you answer its questions.
labEntry.riskQuestion: How much short-term price movement are you comfortable seeing in this learning simulation?
labEntry.riskHelp: There is no correct level. This choice is not saved and is not a real-world suitability assessment.

lower.title: Lower risk comfort
lower.body: Prefer slower, basket-level decisions with more emphasis on exposure gates.

balanced.title: Balanced risk comfort
balanced.body: Accept measured price movement when entry, loss, and sizing rules are explicit.

higher.title: Higher risk comfort
higher.body: Comfortable studying faster intraday moves and tighter decision windows.

lower.title: Governing trend exposure at the whole-basket level
lower.body: Study how one policy gates new exposure across a basket instead of reacting to each stock independently.
lower.reason: Matched for this exercise because its decisions are basket-level and its regime gate can keep new exposure out when conditions weaken.

balanced.title: Buying temporary weakness inside an uptrend
balanced.body: Study a mean-reversion policy with explicit entry distance, stop, holding period, and volatility budget choices.
balanced.reason: Matched for this exercise because it combines measured opportunity with visible loss and position-sizing boundaries.

higher.title: Trading an opening-range break only in active liquid names
higher.body: Study an intraday breakout policy that makes faster decisions around the opening range in active, liquid stocks.
higher.reason: Matched for this exercise because intraday movement and short decision windows make the learning path more demanding.

labEntry.emptyTitle: Choose a risk-comfort level to reveal your strategy
labEntry.emptyBody: Your matched strategy and the button to its questions will appear here.
labEntry.disclosure: Educational matching and replay using virtual money. Risk comfort here is not financial profiling, investment advice, or a promise of future performance; every strategy can lose.

StrategyLearning.title: Turn a strategy into decisions you can explain
StrategyLearning.subtitle: Learn one team’s decision process, make the same bounded choices, then compare your sealed policy with the team and market references.
StrategyLearning.disclosure: Educational simulation only—not investment advice. Results are a frozen historical replay, not a live track record. Sharia execution remains blocked while screening is unverified.
StrategyLearning.loadErrorTitle: The lesson could not be loaded
StrategyLearning.loadErrorBody: Your progress has not started. Try loading the reviewed curriculum again.
StrategyLearning.emptyBody: A reviewed strategy lesson will appear here when it is ready.
StrategyLearning.conceptBody: This reviewed lesson turns the selected strategy’s entry, exit, sizing, holding, and risk rules into bounded choices. Its historical outcome stays hidden until you seal those choices.

entry.title: Read the entry rule
entry.body: Identify the exact conditions that must be true before this strategy may take exposure.

risk.title: Keep risk bounded
risk.body: Choose only among reviewed sizing, exposure, and loss-control limits; external caps remain binding.

discipline.title: Define the discipline
discipline.body: Set how the strategy exits, holds, or re-evaluates before seeing the historical replay.

guardrails.sealed: Outcomes stay hidden until every decision is sealed.
guardrails.bounded: Choices are reviewed strategy bounds, not unrestricted trading controls.
guardrails.mastery: Learning rewards process and recall—not simulated profit.

StrategyLearning.sealTitle: Seal your policy before seeing outcomes
StrategyLearning.sealBody: Review your decisions carefully. After sealing, this attempt is immutable and the same frozen replay is used for every comparison.
StrategyLearning.submitErrorBody: Your choices are still here. Retry the same submission safely; a duplicate attempt will not be created.
StrategyLearning.comparisonDescription: Your policy, the strategy team, SPUS, and price-only SPY rebased to 100 over the same frozen out-of-sample period.
StrategyLearning.resultBody: All four lines use the same frozen out-of-sample interval. Use the comparison to inspect decision mechanics; one favorable outcome can still be luck rather than skill.
StrategyLearning.metricsBody: Return is shown beside maximum drawdown, annualized volatility, and trade count so performance is never presented without its risk context.
StrategyLearning.choicesTitle: How your choices changed the mechanism
StrategyLearning.choicesBody: These explanations connect each policy choice to exposure and behavior without claiming that one historical result proves skill.
StrategyLearning.reflectionBody: Which choice changed risk most, and would you keep it if the return line had finished below the team?
StrategyLearning.shariaBlocked: This educational universe has not completed AAOIFI screening. Learning is available, but execution remains blocked.
StrategyLearning.latestAttemptBody: Return to your reflection now and the spaced retrieval check when it becomes available.
StrategyLearning.masteryBody: XP follows completion, reflection, and spaced recall. It never changes with profit, loss, or benchmark rank.
StrategyLearning.reflectionPrompt: If the return line were reversed, which principle would still guide your next attempt?

reflectionChoices.PROCESS_OVER_OUTCOME: Judge the quality of the process before the outcome.
reflectionChoices.RISK_OVER_RETURN: Check drawdown and exposure before celebrating return.
reflectionChoices.DISCIPLINE_BEFORE_ENTRY: Keep entry and exit rules sealed before acting.

StrategyLearning.retrievalAvailable: Come back after {date}. Spacing the recall makes it a stronger learning signal.
StrategyLearning.masterySaveError: This milestone was not saved. Your recorded attempt is unchanged; try again.
StrategyLearning.xpDisclosure: Fixed process reward: +20 completion, +15 reflection, +15 retrieval. No streak penalty, random prize, or P&L multiplier.

QuantResults.errorDescription: The persisted validation evidence could not be loaded. No result was replaced or inferred.
QuantResults.title: Strategy League
QuantResults.subtitle: Competing strategy teams measured under the same terminal validation rules. Rejection remains visible evidence, not a hidden result.
QuantResults.simulatedDisclosure: Backtests are simulated research, not a live track record or investment advice. ACCEPTED means admission to isolated paper testing only.
QuantResults.shariaDisclosure: Sharia status is a hard execution gate. Unscreened or unverified teams remain blocked even when performance gates pass.
QuantResults.emptyBody: Accepted and rejected teams will appear after a DB-backed validation run reaches a terminal status.
QuantResults.plotDescription: Each labeled point is one strategy team. Horizontal position is out-of-sample CAGR; vertical position is Monte Carlo 95th-percentile maximum drawdown. Promotion uses each run's persisted validation checklist.
QuantResults.plotReadingDescription: Move right for stronger out-of-sample return. Move up for lower modeled drawdown risk. The preferred area is the upper-right: more return with less risk. A point can look attractive and still fail another promotion gate.
QuantResults.plotReturnReadoutHint: Annualized return in the held-out period; simulated, not a live track record.
QuantResults.plotUnavailable: This graph is unavailable because these terminal runs did not persist Monte Carlo p95 drawdown. No substitute metric has been inferred.
QuantResults.plotOmittedCount: {count} team(s) are omitted because Monte Carlo p95 drawdown was not persisted.
QuantResults.standingsDescription: Every terminal strategy team, ranked by out-of-sample CAGR. Select a row to inspect its full evidence below.
QuantResults.teamPerformanceDescription: Persisted simulated evidence for the selected team. Returns include modeled costs and slippage; they are not a live track record.

learningGate.title: Understand the team before opening its evidence
learningGate.lockedBody: Answer a few strategy questions, seal your choices, and inspect your simulated policy beside this team, SPUS, and the price-only S&P 500 proxy. Detailed team evidence opens after that sealed comparison.
learningGate.unlockedBody: Your sealed strategy comparison is complete. The persisted team evidence below is now open for deeper inspection.
learningGate.errorTitle: Mastery status could not be checked
learningGate.errorBody: Detailed evidence remains closed until the recorded learning attempt can be verified. No progress was changed.
learningGate.pendingTitle: This team’s learning replay is being validated
learningGate.pendingBody: A team-specific lesson and deterministic short replay must pass the same data, cost, Sharia, and risk checks before this gate is activated. Until then, the persisted research evidence below remains available and clearly labeled simulated.

QuantResults.performanceTableDescription: The same persisted run, split so you can see whether performance held up on unseen data.
QuantResults.tradeLedgerUnavailableTitle: Trade ledger was not recorded for this run
QuantResults.tradeLedgerUnavailableBody: This is an older validation run from before exact trade records were persisted. Its verified aggregate metrics remain visible, but per-stock gains cannot be reconstructed honestly. A future bounded validation run will populate this ledger.
QuantResults.tradeLedgerEmptyTitle: No closed trades in this run
QuantResults.tradeLedgerEmptyBody: The strategy did not complete a sell record during this test period, so there is no realized per-stock gain to show.
QuantResults.symbolPnlTitle: Realized gain and loss by stock
QuantResults.tradeBasisShared: Net P&L comes from the shared simulated strategy book. Open-position and mark-to-market gains are excluded.
QuantResults.tradeBasisSleeves: Dollar P&L sums independent per-symbol simulations; it is not one investable portfolio total. Open-position and mark-to-market gains are excluded.
QuantResults.tradeLedgerTruncated: Showing the newest {shown} of {total} exact records. Per-stock totals still include every record.
QuantResults.hintCagr: Compound Annual Growth Rate: The average annual percentage growth of the strategy over the test period.
QuantResults.hintSharpe: Sharpe Ratio: Measures risk-adjusted return. It shows if returns are from smart risk-taking or excessive risk. Higher is better.
QuantResults.hintDsr: Deflated Sharpe Ratio: Sharpe ratio adjusted downwards to account for selection bias (trying many variants until one looks good).
QuantResults.hintMaxDrawdown: Maximum Drawdown: The largest peak-to-trough drop in value during the backtest period.
QuantResults.hintHitRate: Hit Rate: The percentage of successful (profitable) trades out of the total closed transactions.
QuantResults.hintTrades: Trades: The total number of completed buy-and-sell cycles executed by this strategy version.
QuantResults.hintOos: Out-of-Sample: A holdout testing period of data the strategy never saw during training, simulating real live performance.
QuantResults.hintMcDrawdown: Monte Carlo Drawdown: Reshuffles historical trades randomly 1,000 times to simulate worst-case potential drawdown risk at a 95% confidence level.
QuantResults.gatesDescription: Every gate is deterministic and cumulative. One failure is enough to reject the tested version.
QuantResults.noRejectionReasons: All terminal gates passed; admission is limited to isolated paper testing.
QuantResults.hintHistoryTitle: Select a strategy team from the standings list above (e.g., bollinger-mr-long-v2 or ts-momentum-halal-basket-v2) to view its normalized historical equity curve compared with SPY and SPUS benchmarks. Some legacy runs do not have comparison data.
QuantResults.historyDescription: A common-period learning view rebased to 100. The three highest-ranked comparable strategies appear first; the selected strategy stays visible, with the remaining persisted curves available on demand beside broad-market and Sharia-screened ETF proxies.
QuantResults.historyDisclosure: The model line is pooled, simulated, trade-sequenced equity—not a daily investable portfolio. SPY is an S&P 500 ETF proxy and SPUS is a Sharia-screened ETF proxy, both based on close prices. Dividends are not modeled. Only the common period is shown. This is not a live track record or investment advice.
QuantResults.historyUnavailableTitle: Historical comparison requires a reproducible rerun
QuantResults.historyUnavailableBody: This legacy result did not persist the model and benchmark evidence needed for an honest chart. Rerun the frozen strategy reproducibly; no curve has been inferred.
QuantResults.historyPlotDescription: Normalized model, SPY, and SPUS values from {start} to {end}. The selected strategy’s out-of-sample period begins {oos}.
QuantResults.historyTopThreeNote: {count} of the top 3 have persisted curves for this exact test period. Missing evidence is never inferred; a selected lower-ranked strategy is pinned when available.
QuantResults.hintHistoryModel: Strategy Model: The simulated growth curve of the strategy's equity, net of estimated transaction costs and slippage.
QuantResults.hintHistoryPeer: Peer strategy: a persisted simulated strategy curve shown for cross-strategy context. It is not a live track record.
QuantResults.hintHistorySpy: SPY: A standard S&P 500 ETF proxy representing broad, unscreened US stock market performance.
QuantResults.hintHistorySpus: SPUS: A Sharia-compliant ETF proxy tracking the S&P 500 Shariah Index, containing only halal-certified US equities.
QuantResults.historyOosOutside: The OOS period begins {oos}, outside the displayed common benchmark period, so its boundary is not drawn.

reason.INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE: The validation sample contained fewer than 100 trades.
reason.OOS_FAILURE: Out-of-sample return or walk-forward validation did not pass.
reason.DSR_FAILURE: Out-of-sample Deflated Sharpe did not exceed 0.95.
reason.DRAWDOWN_RISK_FAILURE: Monte Carlo drawdown or risk of ruin exceeded its limit.
reason.IMPLAUSIBLE_RESULT: The result triggered the implausibility safeguard.
reason.NO_PROFIT_PLATEAU_OVERFIT: A stable profit plateau across nearby parameters was not demonstrated.
reason.SHARIA_NON_COMPLIANT: The Sharia screen found this universe non-compliant.
reason.SHARIA_UNVERIFIABLE: Sharia compliance was not verified, so execution remains blocked.
reason.DATA_QUALITY_PIT_FAILURE: Point-in-time data quality was not verified.
reason.REPRODUCIBILITY_FAILURE: The run did not satisfy the reproducibility gate.

QuantLab.title: Run a validation
QuantLab.subtitle: Launch a strategy validation on real stored bars — pick a strategy, a universe (all markets, one stock, or a basket), and a period. Results are simulated backtest statistics, never a promise of returns. Only a FULL-period run can produce a promotion verdict.
QuantLab.universeWideNote: Every NASDAQ symbol with real stored history (~2,800). Runs on the 1-year period only and can take a while.
QuantLab.universeCustomNote: One stock or a basket — type symbols and press Enter.
QuantLab.universeFixed: This strategy trades its own codified book; the universe cannot be overridden.
QuantLab.wideOneYearOnly: All-markets runs are limited to the 1-year period
QuantLab.evidenceViewNote: Shorter periods are evidence views: useful signal, but never a promotion verdict.
QuantLab.fullPeriodNote: The full period is the only basis for an ACCEPTED verdict.
QuantLab.runningHint: Running on real bars — this can take several minutes. You can keep browsing; the result appears here.
QuantLab.needSymbols: Add at least one symbol to run on selected stocks.
QuantLab.runInProgress: A validation is already running for your account — wait for it to finish.
QuantLab.notAllowed: Your account tier does not have access to the strategy lab.
QuantLab.invalidRequest: The run request was rejected — check the selections and try again.
QuantLab.networkError: Couldn't reach the server. Try again.
